refnamediv.refpurpose: Design a Chebyshev type I filter with specified passband ripple.

refsynopsisdiv.title: Syntax
refsynopsisdiv.synopsis: [b, a] = cheby1(n, rp, wp) [b, a] = cheby1(n, rp, wp, "high") [b, a] = cheby1(n, rp, [wl, wh]) [b, a] = cheby1(n, rp, [wl, wh], "stop") [z, p, g] = cheby1(...) [...] = cheby1(..., "s")

listitem.para: Positive integer. Order of the filter.
Non-negative scalar. Passband ripple in dB.
Positive real value. Normalized digital or analog passband edge(s).

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: This function generates a Chebyshev type I filter with rp dB of passband ripple. if second parameter is scalar the fourth parameter takes in high or low, default value is low. The cutoff is pi*Wc radians. [b, a] = cheby1(n, Rp, [Wl, Wh]) indicates a band pass filter with edges pi*Wl and pi*Wh radians. [b, a] = cheby1(n, Rp, [Wl, Wh], ’stop’) indicates a band reject filter with edges pi*Wl and pi*Wh radians. [z, p, g] = cheby1(...) returns filter as zero-pole-gain rather than coefficients of the numerator and denominator polynomials. [...] = cheby1(...,’s’) returns a Laplace space filter, w can be larger than 1 rad/sec.
